definitions.explanation: A device that shows or signals a state or direction. Most commonly refers to a vehicle's turn signal, but also covers gauges and indicator lamps in machinery.

examples.japanese: {指示器|しじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I signaled with the turn indicator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{指示器|しじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{指示器|しじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}さ→出す：01087_dasu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}→車線変更：17361_shasenhenkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: Changing lanes without signaling is dangerous.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧ (indication) + {器|き} (device, instrument). In driving contexts, refers to the turn signal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指示器|しじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to use the turn signal
- ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧{指示器|しじき}: direction indicator (full term)
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{指示器|しじき}: right turn signal
- {指示器|しじき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to turn on the indicator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ウインカー: blinker, turn signal — the common loanword for car turn signals
- ⟦{方向指示器|ほうこうしじき}→方向指示器：29981_houkoushijiki⟧: direction indicator — the full formal term
- ⟦メーター→メーター：23517_meetaa⟧: meter, gauge — for measurement displays generally
